statements.subject: server
statements.description: If there are any bodies whose type (indicated by the Content-Type), language (indicated by the Content-Language) or encoding (indicated by the Content-Encoding) are not understood, and that body part is not optional (as indicated by the Content-Disposition header field), the UAS MUST reject the request with a 415 (Unsupported Media Type) response.
statements.pre_cond: (body.type.understood = false | body.language.understood = false | body.encoding.understood = false) & body.optional = false
actions: reject request with 415 Unsupported Media Type response

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The response MUST contain an Accept header field listing the types of all bodies it understands, in the event the request contained bodies of types not supported by the UAS.
actions: include Accept header field listing all understood body types in 415 response

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the request contained content encodings not understood by the UAS, the response MUST contain an Accept-Encoding header field listing the encodings understood by the UAS.
actions: include Accept-Encoding header field listing understood encodings in 415 response

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the request contained content with languages not understood by the UAS, the response MUST contain an Accept-Language header field indicating the languages understood by the UAS.
actions: include Accept-Language header field indicating understood languages in 415 response
